text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Abandoning their hopes of sailing off the island,
{0}, Tamaki and Mifuyu return to the task
of exploring their new home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とタマキ、ミフユは、
海に出るのを諦め、島の中を探検することにした。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Now then... We've gathered plenty of food,
so I think it's time we explored the island's center.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて……
食料もたくさん持ったし、
今日は島の中心を目指すわよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Nothing will change if we don't take action,
and there's still a chance we'll find people deeper in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままじゃらちが明かないし、
中心に行けば人がいるかもしれないわ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I'm nyot sure there's much point in going,
but I don't have any better ideas.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん……
行ってもあんまり意味ない気がするけど、
とりあえず言う通りにするにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... We've come quite a ways...
This island is bigger than I thought...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
結構歩いたわね……
それにしても広い島ね……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: But the scenery's been the same this whole way...
text_block_list.orig_text: 景色がさっきからなんにも変わんないにゃ～……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Look, another cat! Aren't you a little cutie! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
　
あそこにまた猫！
　かわい～にゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please... Could you forget about the cats
and try to find something more useful?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーもう、
猫ばっかり見てないで、
なにか違うものを見つけて！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Something like what...?
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃにかって言われても……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I really need to get off this island, and soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は早く……
早く帰らないといけないのよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
W-well, I knyow that!
I'm sure the other Mercurius Foundation members are worried sick...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それはわかってるにゃ！
きっと今頃【メルクリウス財団】のみんなが心配して……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
If I don't get back soon...
I'll miss the big bargain sale in Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く帰らないと……
ランドソルでバーゲンセールが始まっちゃうのよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Bargains?
[i]That's[/i] why you want to get back?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
　バーゲン？
バーゲンのために帰りたいにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! Bargains are a big deal! No, they're outright war!
What kind of mercenary deserts in the face of battle?!
Bargains to me are as important as my own life!
text_block_list.orig_text:
当然でしょ！
　バーゲンは一大イベント！
　いえ、
戦争なのよ！
それに参戦せずして何のための傭兵！？
私にとってバーゲンは、
命に匹敵するぐらい大事なものなのよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: R-right... Well, to each their own, I suppose...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
うん……
まあいろんな価値観があるからにゃー……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Urghh... Bargains... My bargains...
I haven't seen one in so long, I'm getting withdrawal symptoms...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
バーゲン、
バーゲン……
バーゲンに行けなさすぎて
禁断症状が出てきたわ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh...! Bargains! Bargains!
I don't care how or what, I just need to see a bargain sale!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……！
　バーゲン！
　バーゲン……！
なんでもいいからバーゲンセールをちょうだいいい！！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu... A-are you OK...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユ……
だ、
大丈夫かにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I think I see some buildings over there.
Looks tidier than the rest of the island...
But there's no sign of people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　あそこにお店っぽい建物群があるにゃ。
比較的綺麗みたいだけど……
人の気配はないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's some kind of flyer here. What's this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
貼り紙がしてあるにゃ……
なになに？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ……？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Tamaki?
What does that flyer say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの、
タマキさん？
それ、
なんて書いてあるの？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyo... This must be some kind of mistake.
I've never seen a flyer like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
これ間違いじゃないのかにゃ？
こんなお知らせ、見たことないにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Let me take a look too. Let's see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私にもちょっと見せて？
　なになに……？

text_block_list.name: Flyer
text_block_list.text:
\"We're holding a bargain sale on bargain sales!
Buy our 90%-off coupons at 90% off!
Regards, your friendly neighborhood unmanned shopping district.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
【バーゲンセールのバーゲンセール開催中！
９割引きで商品が買える権利９割引き！】
※当商店街は無人商店街です

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wha... Wha... Wha... Whaaaaaaaaaaaat?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんですってーーーーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
A-a-a-a-a-
a \"bargain sale on bargain sales\"?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バ、
バババ
『バーゲンセールのバーゲンセール』ですってーーーー！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Coupons for 90% off available at 90% off...
But that means... It's basically 99% off, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
９割引きで商品を買える権利を９割引き……
つまり……
ほぼ99％オフってこと！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen a bargain like it! How wonderful!
A bargain sale on bargain sales...
This is the stuff dreams are made of! I'm in heaven!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すっごくお得じゃない！
　すてきっ！
　
バーゲンセールのバーゲンセールなんて、
こんなの素晴らし過ぎるわーーー！
　夢みたい！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: E-ehhh...?! Y-you're not making any sense...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
え～？
　わ、
わけわかんないにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? What's this...?
There's some kind of machine hidden in the grass over there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　あれ……
あそこの茂みの中に、
なんだか大きな機械があるにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
\"Automatic Taiyaki Maker for Cat Lovers\"?!
Wh-what is this contraption?!
I've nyever seen anything like it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『猫好みの全自動・たい焼き機』！？
こ、
これはすごいにゃーーー！
こんなのみたことないにゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I-if I twist... this key...
Oh! The machine started rumbling!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
このネジを
巻くと……
おっ、
機械が動き始めたにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: A pile of steaming taiyaki came out!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: たい焼きが出てきたにゃーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Where did all these cats come from?!
Hey, kitties! You like this taiyaki, do you?
Here, eat on up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
猫もたくさん集まってきたにゃー！
君たち、
このたい焼きが欲しいにゃ？
はい、
どうぞにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this coin...? I'm nyot sure where you found it,
but are you trying to pay me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　このコインは……
どこから拾ってきたか知らないけど、
代金のつもりでくれるのかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahahah! Well, thank you!
I guess this must be the currency these cats use?
What a purr-fect reward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃははっ、
ありがとにゃ！
これ、
この島の猫にとってのお金なのかにゃ？
いいものもらっちゃったにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
If I use this machine,
cats everywhere will love me... and I'll be rich to boot!
It's a double whammy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この機械があれば、
猫に大人気になって……
お金持ちにもなれる……
一石二鳥……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: This is no island, it's a paradise!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ここはなんてすばらしい島なのにゃーーーーー！！！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's fishy about this at all! The world's a big place!
Why shouldn't there be an Automatic Taiyaki Maker for Cat Lovers
out there somewhere?! It's like this island was made for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何も変なことなんてないにゃ！
　世界は広いんだから
どこかには
『猫好みの全自動・たい焼き機』があってもいいはずにゃ！
ここはあたしにとってはすばらしい島にゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No, you're the one who needs to calm down and think!
They're selling 90%-off deals at 90% off!
Do you have any idea how amazing that is?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミこそ冷静になって考えてごらんなさい！
９割引きの権利を９割引きにできるのよ！？
どれだけすごいかわかるでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: This really is an island of dreams!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさにここは、
夢の島よ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep!
I'm gonna found a Kitty Kingdom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん！
さっそく猫の国を建国するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
A fine idea! Let's create a utopia of our very own!
A land where everyone can live in luxury
and enjoy efficient peace and security!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいわね！
　私たちの理想の国を作りましょう！
誰もが平和に、
豊かに、
そして効率的に暮らす理想の国……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: The future's so bright!
choice_data_list: Mifuyu, we have to get back home.
text_block_list.orig_text: 夢が膨らむにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: We can escape later! There's no time for that nyow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなの後にゃ！
　今はそんな暇ないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, that wouldn't be an efficient move at all!
Let's think about how to improve our lives here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
今はそんな非効率的なことをするより、
ここで生活する術を考えましょう！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! While we're living a life of luxury,
I'm sure someone will come and find us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！
　優雅にのんびり暮らしてたら、
いつかは誰かが助けに来てくれるにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As Tamaki and Mifuyu basked in the discoveries of their dreams,
{0} could do nothing but stop and stare.
text_block_list.orig_text:
理想的な出来事にすっかり心を奪われるタマキとミフユを、
{0}は見守ることしかできなかった。
